relations.subject: capella:collection
relations.evidence: Documents are organized and grouped in buckets using [scopes and collections](../clusters/data-service/about-buckets-scopes-collections.md).

relations.subject: capella:collection
relations.evidence: If a scope or collection is not provided when creating a document, Couchbase will automatically store data in the `_default` collection or `_default` scope.

relations.subject: sdk:kv-operations
relations.evidence: When a document is created, Couchbase assigns it a [CAS (Compare and Swap)](../../java-sdk/current/howtos/concurrent-document-mutations.md) value to keep track of the document's state within the database.

relations.subject: sdk:kv-operations
relations.evidence: To specify further parameters for the inserted document, such as expiry, add the options to the insert operation.

notable_absence.finding: Unlike the cloud/n1ql/n1ql-language-reference pages (e.g. insert.md's privilege:capella-basic-access-write / privilege:capella-advanced-access-query-insert), this KV-operation guide page never mentions RBAC, credential type, or required privileges for creating a document via cbsh or an SDK - the whole access-control axis the n1ql reference pages carry is simply absent from the task-oriented guide.

cross_component_finding: This page is a thin task-wrapper: every operation it demonstrates (insert, insert-with-expiry) is already fully documented in java-sdk/howtos/kv-operations.md and cloud/clusters/data-service/about-buckets-scopes-collections.md. No new concept was needed. It also duplicates, verbatim, the same warning banner ('Please note that the examples in this guide will alter the data in your sample database...') and the same 'Key-Value Operations with SDKs' related-links list found identically in deleting-data.md, reading-data.md, updating-data.md and bulk-operations.md - exact duplication (not inconsistent wording), consistent with a shared partial/include used across this guide family.
